## ScoreSlotDeallocator_0042ddd0 — DoubleBufferDeallocator

**Summary:** Frees two dynamically allocated buffers stored at this[1] and this[3], then zeros all four pointer slots. Part of score/configuration slot teardown.

**Frame-path:** ON_FRAME_PATH  
**Call frequency:** per-frame tick

**Called by:** sub_42DC00 (0042dc00), GearRatioConfigFileReader (0042de10), TireModelInit (0043e050), sub_45C400 (0045c400), SeasonDataFileSetupChain (0046d060), TelemetryDataDump (004d4a80), sub_4E3360 (004e3360), LargeConfigFunctionWithPhysicsConstants (004e45b0)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| this | 0x0 | RW | 0 | slotBufferPtr1 |
| this | 0x4 | RW | 0 | slotBufferPtr2 |
| this | 0x8 | RW | 0 | slotCount |
| this | 0xC | RW | 0 | slotBufferPtr3 |

**Written-by note (persistence):**
- this 0x0: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist
- this 0x4: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist
- this 0x8: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist
- this 0xC: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist

**Globals referenced:**

| Address | Name | R/W | Role |
|---------|------|-----|------|

**Functions called:**

| Address | Name | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| 00587bcf | FreeWrapper_7bcf | Wrapper around free/memory deallocation |

**Guard conditions:** Checks this[1] and this[3] for non-null before calling FreeWrapper. No early-return — always clears all four fields.
